## Skeleton.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `form` :: The placeholder shape: lines of text, a circle, or a rectangle.
- `lines` :: How many lines to draw when `form` is `text`.
- `animate` :: The loading animation. `none` is a still placeholder.
- `shape` :: The corner of a circle placeholder.
- `loaded` :: Cross-fades from the placeholder to `children` when true.
- `children` :: The real content, revealed when `loaded` is true.
